title: feat(skills): trigger cases for the six metadata skills; eval assertions and prompts that grade the skill
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFyg5B2muWbKZjA9phXVWse)_
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfr1xZSFZzCR8HnqXX

Round 2 (`c169dc85d5`, after L1-e's review and the seat's contract review): the reader refuses a `files` entry that would land under a `.claude/` directory, and the trigger-case paragraph below now describes the query and i18n negatives as they are.

Part of #34789. This PR is the cases and the runner's grading of trigger cases. The card's done-when also needs a model round and #34769 judged on the trigger cases. The round has since run on this PR's runner and cases (`claude-haiku-5-5`, effort medium, at `8d82dcb937`, 476 of 476 turns) and its trigger results are posted as the before baseline for #34769; judging #34769 is still owed, so the card stays open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：六个元数据技能（data、query、ui、automation、formula、i18n）各加 7 条触发用例，共 42 条，其中 12 条是不该加载技能的近似请求；`skill-evals` 运行器按“这一轮是否加载了技能”给触发用例打分，只跑装了技能的一臂，并在汇总里单列。另有 11 条已有用例的断言放宽成任何正确答案都能过；30 条提示词写明“当前目录没有项目文件”及答题所需的上下文；运行器开始支持用例的 `files`，并拒收会落到项目 `.claude/` 下的路径（否则无技能一臂也可能拿到技能）。
- **为什么改**：#34691 S2 裁定 A，本卡是 #34764 留下的那部分。上一轮跑出的失败里，有的只因断言要求某一种写法，有的只因提示词假设磁盘上有项目，与技能无关；而 #34769 改技能描述，需要触发用例才能比较改前改后。
- **风险与回滚**：只动评测用例（随 `@objectstack/skills` 发布，但在使用者项目里不起作用）和只能从检出运行的运行器，不进 CI，不拦合并，dist 里查不到新符号（已实测）。没改的用例哈希不变，旧轮次照常 `--regrade`；改过的 41 条在旧轮次重评时会被单列、不计入通过率。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/run.ts`（`verdictOf` 的触发分支和 `loadEvidence`，风险最高：判定“加载”的口径）；`skills/objectstack-data/evals/triggers.json`（触发用例的形状和反例的选法）；`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts`（读取器的拒收规则）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --dry-run`，应看到 `217 behaviour case(s) × 2 arms + 42 trigger case(s) × the with-skill arm, × 1 = 476 turn(s)` 和 `30 should load the bundle, 12 should not`。
- **需要你做的**：本 PR 改了 `skills/**`（受管面 Tier H），请审批；落地由席位完成。

## What changes

**Trigger cases (scope item 3).** The six metadata skills named by #34769 (`objectstack-data`, `objectstack-query`, `objectstack-ui`, `objectstack-automation`, `objectstack-formula`, `objectstack-i18n`) each gain `evals/triggers.json`: 7 cases each, 42 in all, 12 negative (29 percent; the card asks for at least one in ten). Each bundle has 5 positives (two phrased as building over MCP with no project files, the phrasing #34769 targets; two plain intents; one in Chinese) and 2 negatives. In four bundles (`objectstack-data`, `objectstack-ui`, `objectstack-automation`, `objectstack-formula`) the pair is a neighbouring skill's task inside ObjectStack, which a "Not for" clause should send elsewhere, and a near miss outside ObjectStack. `objectstack-query`'s two are both neighbouring-skill tasks inside ObjectStack: a select field on `ticket` (data) and a filtered list view on `ticket` (ui). `objectstack-i18n`'s two are both near misses outside ObjectStack: react-i18next in a plain React app, and `Intl.NumberFormat` in a Node.js script.

The shape is the existing case entry with `"should_trigger": true | false` in place of `assertions`: `{ "id", "prompt", "should_trigger", "files": [] }`. The runner (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/`):

- reads it strictly. A trigger case carrying `assertions`, a non-boolean `should_trigger`, and a bundle whose trigger cases are all of one kind are refused with a location;
- plans it on the with-skill arm only, since nothing can be loaded without the bundle;
- grades it on the turn, never the answer. The turn loaded the bundle when it launched it with the `Skill` tool or read a file under its `.claude/skills/BUNDLE/`; the record's `trigger.loadedBy` says which. The card's round saw the model reach skill text by reading files more often than by the `Skill` tool, so both count, and the summary shows them apart. A turn that loaded the bundle is judged however it ended. One that did not is judged only on a `success` result, and is `error` otherwise (out of the denominator), because a turn cut short may have been about to load it;
- reports trigger cases in their own summary section beside the behaviour cases and never inside their pass rates: per bundle, loaded when it should, left alone when it should not, missed loads and false loads, and per case the Skill-tool or read-only split. `--regrade` keeps trigger cases planned and regrades them from the records;
- records `skillFilesRead` on every turn, behaviour cases included.

`hashCase` adds the trigger kind and a non-empty `files` list only when a case has them, so every unchanged behaviour case keeps its hash and old rounds regrade as before.

**`files` (scope item 2).** `files` was read by nothing. An entry is now a path under the bundle's `evals/files/`; the reader refuses anything else, and the catalog refuses a path the bundle lacks. The reader also refuses an entry with a `.claude` segment below `evals/files/` (any depth, any letter case): every case file reaches both arms, and `.claude/` is where Claude Code finds skills, so such a file could hand the no-skill arm a skill without `verdictOf` calling the turn invalid. `.mcp.json` is left alone, since the arms run with `--strict-mcp-config`. It is copied, a directory whole, into both arms' directories at its path below `evals/files/`. No case needs it today: every case that read as if a project were on disk was answerable once its prompt said so, which the card prefers.

**Prompts that state their context (scope item 2).** Thirty prompts that named a project file to create or fix, or referred to "our app" state the model would go looking for, now end with one sentence saying none of the project's files are in the directory and what the answer should carry (the file, the change, the commands). Two needed facts as well: `objectstack-api/endpoints-auth-routes#2` named "the lead feed" defined only by case #1, and now describes it; `#6` asked to "fix the import body" without giving it, and now gives it. `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#5`, whose right answer refuses the requested file, says "answer from what is stated here" so the sentence does not push toward writing that file.

Changed: `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#1 #4 #5`, `objectstack-api/endpoints-auth-routes#1 #2 #6`, `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#5`, `objectstack-data/objects-fields-relationships#1 #9`, `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#2 #4`, `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#1 #3 #5 #7 #8 #17 #21`, `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#1 #2 #4`, `objectstack-ui/record-page#3`, `objectstack-upgrade/protocol-major-upgrade#1 #2 #3`, `objectui/page-builder#2 #3 #4`, `objectui/project-setup#3`, `objectui/data-integration#3`.

**Assertion review (scope item 1).** Every case's assertions in all 12 bundles were read once, with each `must_contain` token checked mechanically against the bundle's non-eval text and the prompt. A token was changed only when one of these was demonstrated: it is absent from both the skill and the prompt and is one spelling of the answer; the prompt itself spells the answer another way; it names a value the author is free to choose; it is a whole compound expression whose formatting is free; or, for a forbidden token, the prompt or the skill carries it verbatim, so a right answer that names what is wrong quotes it. Eleven cases changed:

| case | was | now | why |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#13` | must `hotcrm.custom` | must `.custom` | absent from the automation skill, which says "the base's paired `.custom` package"; any answer naming the pair carries `.custom` |
| `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#10` | forbid `verdict: {` | forbid `verdict: { summary: '` | a right answer quotes the nested shape as the wrong one; narrowed to the nested key authored with a string value |
| `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#14` | forbid `****` | forbid `'138****` | the prompt and the skill (`references/seeds.md`: no `138****4207`) both carry the masked form, so a right answer naming what is refused quotes it; narrowed to the masked value as an authored string |
| `objectstack-data/objects-fields-relationships#10` | forbid `required: true` | forbid `required: true,` and `required: true }` | the prompt asks for `required`; a right answer declines it by name; narrowed to the key as authored inside an object |
| `objectstack-data/objects-fields-relationships#12` | must `filter: { status: 'completed' }` | must `filter:` | the prompt names neither the status field nor its stored value; the forbidden Chinese-value tokens still carry the case |
| `objectstack-data/objects-fields-relationships#14` | must `value: 'active'` | must `value: '` | the stored value for 合作中 is the author's choice; the forbidden `value: '合作中'` still carries the case |
| `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#16` | must the whole `read: { url: '…' }` object; must `seed: [{ param: 'plan_token', path: 'token' }]` | must the URL `/api/v1/packages/${ctx.recordId}/upgrade-plan?version=${param.version}`; must `seed:` and `path: 'token'` | a whole object as one string binds the formatting; `plan_token` is the author's name for the param |
| `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#5` | forbid `defineAgent(` | forbid `defineAgent({` | the prompt asks for that call and a right answer refuses it by name (`defineAgent()`); narrowed to the authored call |
| `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#6` | must `pendingActions.list` | dropped | absent from the AI skill, which names the list door `GET /api/v1/ai/pending-actions`; the refusal tokens carry the case |
| `objectui/testing#2` | must `React Testing Library` | must `@testing-library/react` | the prompt says "RTL"; a right answer can be all code, and every RTL test imports this module |
| `objectstack-upgrade/protocol-major-upgrade#3` | must `never executed`; forbid `type: 'javascript'` | dropped; forbid `transform: { type: 'javascript'` | the skill says "never ran" and "unexecuted"; the prompt carries the forbidden token verbatim (as ``transform` = { type: 'javascript' …``), narrowed to the re-authored transform |

## Tests

- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts`: two new `describe` blocks, 11 tests. They cover the reader (trigger kind, refusals, the one-kind bundle refusal, `files` paths), the judge (loaded by Skill launch or by read; a same-prefix bundle or another skill is not a load; loaded turns judged on any ending; an unloaded cut-short turn is `error`; the no-skill arm is `invalid`), hash stability for an unchanged behaviour case, a round planning trigger cases on one arm and the summary tallying them apart, `--regrade` keeping trigger cases planned, `files` placed on both arms, and `files` entries under `.claude/` refused (`.claude-notes.md`, `claude/` and `.mcp.json` still read).
- `--self-test`: 9 new rows (roster 21 → 30, floor pinned at 30), run against the real catalog from the CLI.
- Ablation, one behaviour (trigger grading by a read), on the committed tree: deleting the read-evidence line in `loadEvidence` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned 4 tests red (two trigger tests, and the two `--self-test can fail` tests through the self-test's own trigger row); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob equal to HEAD. The suite imports `src/` directly, so no rebuild was involved.
- Ablation, round 2 (the `.claude` refusal), on the committed tree: replacing the refusal's condition with `if (false) {` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `e5f089ae1d12` → `2e9983a9bf81`) turned 3 tests red: the new reader test, and the two `--self-test can fail` tests through the self-test's new row. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **The model round ran separately, after this PR opened.** `claude-haiku-5-5`, effort medium, on `8d82dcb937`: 476 of 476 turns. Trigger cases: 30 of 30 loaded when they should; 8 of 12 left alone, and all 4 false loads were by reading the skill's files only. Behaviour cases: with-skill 130 of 215, no-skill 9 of 217. Trigger baseline ("before") for #34769: [comment 6964639551](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/34789#issuecomment-6964639551). Judging #34769 against that baseline is still owed, so this PR stays Part of #34789. With 1 repetition each negative trigger case is a single turn, so one flip moves a skill's left-alone rate by 50 points; comparisons for #34769 should run with `--repeats 3`. Round 2's `.claude` refusal changes no case in the catalog (none uses `files`), so the round's records still regrade as they are.
- **Reviewed and left as they are**, because no literal token separates the wrong claim from a right answer's negation of it. The grader is a literal substring match by design, and changing behaviour grading is outside this card's file surface:
  - `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#15` forbids `会自动预填`, contained in 不会自动预填;
  - `objectstack-ask/metric-selection-fallback#6` forbids `不存在`;
  - `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#13` forbids `ready to use`;
  - `objectstack-api/endpoints-auth-routes#5` forbids `'search'` and `'restore'`;
  - `objectui/app-composition#3` forbids `"path": "/projects"` and `objectui/protocol#3` forbids `"cols":`, both present verbatim in the prompt with no authored-only form;
  - `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#5` forbids `knowledge:`, verbatim in the prompt;
  - `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#7` requires `do not retry`, the skill's own words (a contraction would miss).
- **Quote style.** Every token in the catalog is spelled with single quotes, as the skills and this codebase write code; an answer in double quotes misses all of them. Not changed: it is the catalog's convention, not one case's spelling.
- **Reach, not spelling, carried by #34789.** `objectstack-api/endpoints-auth-routes#6` requires `sourceField` / `targetField`, which only the spec source teaches (`api/export.zod.ts`), and the turn's empty directory has no `node_modules`. `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#16` requires `notices.`, which lives in `objectstack-data`'s `rules/lifecycle.md`, while the arm installs only the automation bundle. Both fail for a reason other than spelling or a missing project; a round will show whether they need the eval seat's attention.
- **Trigger-arm design limit.** The with-skill arm installs the case's bundle alone, so a negative case asks whether this skill stays out with no competitor present, not which of several skills the model picks. That is the narrower question, and the one #34769's "Not for" clause changes.
- Clause-② measured from the diff: `src/skill-evals/` is in no tsup entry and no export or bin. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`, `should_trigger`, `placeCaseFiles` and `skillFilesRead` hit 0 files under `dist/`, while the control `subscriptionOnlyEnv` hits `dist/cli.js` and `dist/runner.js`. What ships is the README text, hence the `patch` changeset.
- #34949, the serial constraint, merged during this work; this branch merged `origin/main` and calls `prepareArmWorkdir` with its new three-argument form.
